item.description:
Mergekeeper 0.1.2

  • fix(release): build universal binary from two native slices joined with lipo
  • feat(release): release automatically on every code change to main
  • refactor(core): drop legacy keychain and secrets-file migration
  • Merge remote-tracking branch 'origin/main' into an/mergekeeper-keychain-perms-622ce7
  • feat(core): keep secrets out of the login keychain so macOS never prompts
  • chore: repos moved to the vipinsiders org; update owners and feed URLs
  • ci: run tests on pull requests; add PR template
  • feat(release): GitHub tag-triggered release pipeline, setup-ci.sh, agent docs
  • Merge branch 'an/mergekeeper-notification-permissions-e5ad60'
  • docs: add AGENTS.md with the agent deploy instructions
  • feat(notifications): ask for notification permission at launch
  • feat(release): Scripts/ship.sh one-command release; CI release is manual until secrets exist
  • fix(release): find gh outside the shell PATH, fall back to git clone
